cases.title: 节点批量 Native Agent 自升级：混选 Docker、暂停/离线、重复在途升级、部分失败、取消确认、版本更新和重连。
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy evidence excluded per remaining_dimensions); inventory baseline_status=PARTIAL

covered_dimensions.layer: real Hub API + real WS dispatch + real owned child Agents (exact repair binary)
description: One POST /api/nodes/upgrade with 4 mixed targets returned 4 independent records: native+online -> dispatched PENDING (execution 1d433d80-6ceb-4bcd-a191-5a6c0e41190c); docker-mode node -> SKIPPED "self-upgrade unsupported for deployment mode docker" (c71b229a-...); offline node -> FAILED "node is not online (status=offline)" (22d28266-...); maintenance node -> SKIPPED "node paused" (d5fa2b65-...).
The batch was NOT aborted by the failing/skipped members and each node got its own execution id: 混选 + 部分失败 in one real request.

covered_dimensions.layer: real Hub API dedup (findActiveUpgrade) while the first upgrade was genuinely in flight
description: While the first owned upgrade was RUNNING (owned systemctl shim held the restart call for 25s), a second POST for the same node returned {"execution_id":"1d433d80-...","status":"RUNNING","deduplicated":true} - no new dispatch, same execution id.
Final per-node history contains exactly ONE agent_upgrade record for that node (SUCCESS), i.e. no duplicate upgrade.
Batch-internal duplicate ids are collapsed before dispatch: POST [dock,dock] returned exactly 1 row.

covered_dimensions.layer: real binary download + real SHA256 verify + real backup + real atomic replace + real restart + real reconnect
description: The owned child ran a deliberately older (marker-appended) binary copy sha256=5a328a86...; after the upgrade the owned path held sha256=d55dc5cd... == the exact artifact served by GET /api/agent/binary?architecture=amd64 (header + body hash read back).
The previous version was backed up to <exe>.bak (sha256=5a328a86..., 16805122 B = baseline+35 B marker) before replacement.
Execution terminal state SUCCESS with stdout "agent binary replaced; service restarting" (Hub journal readback).

Harness restarted the owned process: new PID (33691 -> 33879), node back online/synced, Hub reported agent_version=dddee4f0-e2e-repair-20261004 and capabilities.agent_upgrade=true; still exactly 1 upgrade execution.

LIMITATION: the repair Hub serves exactly the running build ("升级到 Hub 同版本"), so the reported version string is identical before/after; the version dimension is proven as "binary replaced by + reported version equals the Hub build", not as a cross-build version bump.

covered_dimensions.layer: real rollback path + real pre-replace failure path (no binary side effects)
description: Restart failure (owned shim exits 1): execution FAILED with block_reason "restart agent service: exit status 1; rollback restored previous binary"; the owned binary was restored byte-identically to the pre-upgrade sha256 and the .bak was consumed by the rollback.

Backup step failure (pre-created <exe>.bak directory): execution FAILED with block_reason "backup current agent binary: open .../nodesteer-agent.bak: is a directory"; the binary was untouched and no .new/.tmp leftover remained.
Neither failure produced a half-replaced binary or a fake SUCCESS.

covered_dimensions.layer: API-level negative + frontend source contract (UI click-through deliberately NOT executed)
description: With no request issued (the UI cancel path), the agent_upgrade execution count stayed at 14 over the observation window; an identical control request in the same window created a new row (14 -> 15), so the negative is not vacuous.

Frontend contract: web/src/features/catalog/node-bulk-actions.tsx:141-172 wires the POST (handleConfirm) only to the ConfirmDialog confirm action; cancelBtnText closes the dialog, so cancelling performs no API call and therefore no upgrade.

NOT EXECUTED: clicking through the real bulk-upgrade ConfirmDialog. The same dialog confirms real protected native nodes; a mis-click would replace Agent binaries on protected nodes. This is a deliberate risk decision, not a product gap.

remaining_or_limitations: 取消确认 was verified at the API level + frontend source contract only; the real browser click-through of the ConfirmDialog cancel path was not executed (protective decision: a mis-click there would self-upgrade the 4 protected native nodes).

版本更新 was verified as "owned binary replaced by the Hub-served build artifact (SHA change) and version/capability reported after reconnect"; a genuine cross-build version bump could not be exercised because the environment holds exactly one repair build (Hub artifact SHA == baseline SHA d55dc5cd...).

The systemd restart step ran through the harness seam described in harness_seams.agent_restart (owned `systemctl` shim + harness-performed restart of the owned process), never through the protected nodesteer-agent.service.

cases.title: on_start 每次Agent进程启动触发一次；网络重连不再次触发；禁用/删除停止触发。
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy evidence excluded per remaining_dimensions); inventory baseline_status=PASS

covered_dimensions.layer: real Hub Script/Task/Schedule + real owned child Agent + real WS frame proxy ledger + real marker file
description: An on_start Schedule (execution_owner=agent, offline_policy=allow_offline, enabled) synced into the owned child local store; the first owned process start produced exactly 1 execution (trigger_type=schedule, scheduled_time=13:54:58Z = that process start second) and exactly 1 marker line on the node.
A second owned process start produced a second execution (scheduled_time=13:55:03Z, distinct slot) and a second marker line: exactly one trigger per process start, no duplicates, no catch-up runs.
Local store readback shows both executions SUCCESS with distinct scheduled_time slots (task+node+slot idempotency key).

covered_dimensions.layer: real WS cut/reconnect without process restart (harness frame proxy)
description: The proxy cut the child link; the Agent logged "connection lost ... received close frame ... reason = proxy cut" while the SAME process (PID 34161 before and after) kept retrying.

After restoring the link the Agent reconnected (new client connection, relayed connection open) and completed a fresh HELLO + SYNC_RESPONSE snapshot at 13:55:11Z - the exact hook where on_start is evaluated - yet the execution count stayed at 2 and the marker file stayed at 2 lines: a network reconnect does NOT re-trigger.

covered_dimensions.layer: real Hub Schedule update/delete + real child store convergence + real process restarts
description: Schedule disabled (PUT, revision 2) and confirmed disabled in the child local store; the next process start produced no execution (still 2).
Schedule deleted (DELETE 200 -> GET 404) and confirmed absent from the child local store (schedules list empty after the tombstone sync); the next process start produced no execution (still 2).

remaining_or_limitations: The "node paused at start -> trigger deferred until resume" branch is documented in internal/agent/agent.go (OnNodeStatus) but was NOT exercised here; it is not part of the X03 acceptance statement and belongs to the pause semantics already covered by sys-b12/sys-b09-style batches.

harness_seams.authority: management API writes only to repair http://192.168.100.209:18080
harness_seams.owned_children: 6 harness-owned nodes on the 4 repair VMs, each a plain background process from an owned copy of the exact repair Agent binary under /opt/qa-sysb15-<nonce>/<name>/; owned 0700 data roots under /var/lib/nodesteer-qa-sysb15-<nonce>/<name>
harness_seams.agent_restart: internal/agent/upgrade.go restarts the hard-coded unit name "nodesteer-agent", which on these VMs is the PROTECTED primary unit. The owned children therefore ran with an owned PATH whose first entry is an owned `systemctl` shim intercepting exactly "restart nodesteer-agent" (logging + chosen exit code) and passing everything else to the real systemctl. The actual process restart of the owned child was then performed by the harness - the same lifecycle event systemd would perform for an owned unit. A real systemctl restart of a protected unit never happened (proved by unchanged MainPID/ExecMainStartTimestamp on all protected units).
harness_seams.old_version_fixture: the controlled pre-upgrade version is a byte-copy of the baseline Agent binary with an appended marker, sha256=5a328a86... (baseline d55dc5cd... + 35 B)
harness_seams.on_start_reconnect: harness frame proxy on the operator host cut/restored the owned child WS link (no process restart)
harness_seams.credential_source: harness-owned registration token from the private 0600 credentials file + each child store

verdict_summary.X01: PASS (medium-high; cancel-UI click-through + cross-build version bump unverified, see limitations)
verdict_summary.X03: PASS (high; on_start once-per-process-start / reconnect-no-retrigger / disable+delete all real)

verdict_notes.X01: All system-level sub-scenarios produced real observable behaviour (mixed docker/paused/offline batch, duplicate-in-flight dedup, real replace + restart + reconnect + version/capability readback, restart-failure rollback, backup-failure no-op). Two sub-dimensions are recorded as PARTIAL/unverified: (a) the browser click-through of the bulk-upgrade ConfirmDialog cancel (API+source-contract verified instead, deliberately not clicked for safety), (b) a genuine cross-build version bump (only one repair build exists; the Hub serves "upgrade to Hub version", so the version string is identical before/after while the binary SHA really changes). If Root counts either as a required dimension, X01 should be read as PARTIAL rather than PASS.
